From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sara Morrison <sara.morrison@lumenworks.com>, Tim Jensen <tim.jensen@lumenworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: LumenWorks impact profile: discovery conversation & recording approval

Hi Sara / Tim —

Thanks again for agreeing to share LumenWorks’ story. We’re aiming to do a 30–40 minute discovery call to capture the customer impact, technical highlights, and measurable outcomes. Goal is a short written case study and a 90–second quote video (if you’re open to that).

Proposed agenda (30–40 min):
- Quick intros (5 min)
- Business context & objectives (10 min)
- Results & metrics (10 min)
- Tools/workflow + technical notes (5 min)
- Next steps & review timeline (5 min)

Would you be comfortable with us recording the session for note-taking and the potential short clip? We’ll send the consent form in advance and can redact anything you flag.

Suggested times (PT):
- Mon Aug 31, 10:00–10:40
- Mon Aug 31, 13:00–13:40
- Tue Sep 1, 09:00–09:40

Attachments: Case_Study_Guide.pdf (one-page prep), LumenWorks_Consent_Form.docx (consent template).

Marissa (CS) and Monica (Product Marketing) will join to help with the narrative and capture metrics. If there are additional stakeholders you want included (legal/comms), please let us know.

If these slots don’t work, tell us a couple windows and we’ll coordinate.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Monica — I’ll loop in our comms lead if we plan to publish anything beyond a written case study. Tim and I can make Monday Aug 31 at 1pm PT work.

A couple of quick items: 
- On metrics: we’ll need to agree on the specific numbers we can make public (our finance team has guidelines).
- On the video: we can do a short recorded comment from our Head of Ops — we’ll confirm availability after this call.

See you Monday 1pm PT. Please send calendar invite.
